# Preservation & Documentation

The Center for Wooden Boats documents its boats to preserve their details and legacy.

![Digital scan of a boat](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5c48db894eddeca43abfade1/1555106808304-26IFMRCPMX4EUSP0CQKN/Cover-Photo-1-630x314.jpg)

### Preservation with 3D Models
In 2014, CWB ran a year-long experiment, funded by the Institute of Museum and Library Services, to test digital photogrammetry as a way of monitoring the shape of large objects over time.

[Learn More →](https://www.cwb.org/3d-preservation)

![A slide help up to a window shows a sailboat at the Floating Boathouse while under construction in the late 1980's.](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5c48db894eddeca43abfade1/4a4b2af0-74bb-43f2-bc28-0f3c43d74d4d/BoathouseSlide-IMG_5042.jpg)

### Preview of Coming Attractions
CWB is building a digital catalog of its boat fleets and other maritime artifacts acquired over the past 45 years. The catalog will be accessible through the website and through QR codes posted on the docks. This project is supported in part by 4Culture.

![4Culture logo](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5c48db894eddeca43abfade1/e308c25f-142b-44ff-9e46-1dd4b170f0bb/4Culture-Logo-GC11-c.png)

![CAD drawings of a Blanchard Junior Knockabout hull](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5c48db894eddeca43abfade1/1555106627229-NXYWGB46IN24PMUPD44P/STL-shots-630x314.jpg)

### Documentation Through CAD
In 2016, CWB explored 3D modeling with Computer Aided Design (CAD) programs.

[Learn More →](https://www.cwb.org/cad)
